title: Existence and uniqueness of the normalized comparison on a quasi-compact separated scheme
statement: For a quasi-compact separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], there exists a unique family of additive equivalences c(F,q) from Zariski module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] to cohomology of the lifted associated etale sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], for all quasi-coherent F [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and natural q. Transporting c by the inverse fixed moduleAbelianCohomologyLarge comparison gives IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]: coefficient naturality, section normalization and compatibility with connecting Ext classes. Moreover c(F,0) sends the image of s under the degree-zero right-derived sections map to the class whose terminal evaluation is ULift.up(tensorSectionsUnit s). The same family is directly natural for every module coefficient morphism, between module-derived cohomology and lifted etale cohomology. There is no scheme morphism, arbitrary scheme-pullback naturality or scalar-specialization clause in this assertion.

source.place: Tag 03P2, separated-case proof; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 03FD; homology.tex Tag 010T

proof.text: Use the continuous representably flat inclusion of Zariski opens in the etale site. Its left adjoint on abelian sheaves preserves finite limits and colimits. Identify tensor sections on open objects with ordinary sections; the inverse identifications give a natural coefficient map after lifting and taking the adjunction transpose. Map Ext classes by this exact functor, precompose with the lifted integer generator, and postcompose with the coefficient map. Ext functoriality and naturality of short-exact extension classes prove naturality and compatibility with connecting classes. The adjunction unit and terminal-object transport give tensorSectionsUnit in degree zero.

Choose the finite subcover of the affine cover and its disjoint union Y. The morphism Y to X is affine since X is separated. Restriction to a covering is jointly faithful, hence pullback to Y is faithful and the adjunction unit F to g_*g^*F is monic. Its target is quasi-coherent, since pushforward along an affine morphism preserves quasi-coherence. The affine cohomology edge identifies its abelian cohomology with that on the affine Y; affine vanishing and the module/abelian source comparison give vanishing of its positive module cohomology. Quasi-coherent cokernel closure supplies the quotient.

The underlying abelian-sheaf functor is exact. Etale tensor pullback is exact by flatness: left exactness gives sectionwise monicity, right exactness gives the cokernel after sheafification, and additive coefficient lift preserves the resulting short exact sequence. The ordinary etale/Zariski comparison and its coefficient-lift comparison transfer the acyclicity of the pushforward to both cohomology theories. These sequences give the Effaces data.

Apply normalized_zero_bijective and normalized_bijective to the normalized additive morphism and the common effacements. This gives additive equivalences in every degree. The same effacements and normalized_unique show equality with any other normalized family.

Transport these equivalences through the fixed moduleAbelianCohomologyLarge. Its degree-zero formula identifies the derived unit of an actual section with that section. The proved naturality of the fixed module resolution comparison, followed by Ext universe transport, gives direct module naturality: both Ext presentations send postcomposition to composition with the same degree-zero derived morphism. Cancel the inverse fixed comparison to obtain uniqueness of the transported family.

theorem exists_unique_qcoherentNormalizedComparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [Scheme.IsSeparated X] :
    ∃! c : ∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ),
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q,
      IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison X
          (fun F _ q ↦ (moduleAbelianCohomologyLarge X F q).symm.trans (c F q)) ∧
        (∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : Γ(F, ⊤)),
          Sheaf.H.equiv₀ (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) terminalIsTerminal
            (c F 0
              ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app F s)) =
            ULift.up (tensorSectionsUnit (⊤_ X.Etale).hom F s)) ∧
        ∀ (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
          (φ : F ⟶ G) (q : ℕ)
          (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F),
          c G q ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).map φ x) =
            Sheaf.H.map (coherentEtaleMap F G φ) q (c F q x)
